query: SELECT id, name, family FROM molecules WHERE family LIKE '%Terpène%' OR family LIKE '%terpène%' OR name IN ('Myrcène', 'Limonène', 'α-Pinène', 'β-Pinène', 'β-Caryophyllène', 'Linalool', 'Humulène') ORDER BY id LIMIT 10;
